method: PGM P5 and simple YAML reparsed from raw bytes with the standard library; occupancy follows the conservative ROS convention free only when probability < free_thresh
canonical G4 grid summary and SHA-256 recomputed without the project module

collision error envelope recomputed from the recorded binary64 fields; the per-side closure (margin-baseline)/2 >= max(e_i) and the two-body gap reduction are verified with exact Fraction arithmetic on the recorded floats, and radius_upper is checked by squared rational enclosure of the actual checker half extents

independent Simpson audit budget rebuilt from the serialised C2 knots and recorded per-panel M4 bounds with the documented outward rounding; dense samples of the actual fourth derivative are required to lie below every recorded panel bound, and the fixed threshold is 5e-8 m
per-lambda declared bounds checked against the independent lower bounds recorded by the adapter; no segment self-report is trusted alone
dynamic max-utilization, whole-domain certificate and all three pointwise interval ratios checked below one

nonclaims: six frozen known-feasible A-only scenes; no general success rate, completeness or optimality is claimed
no real-time, hard-deadline or production acceptance claim
no ROS, Gazebo, hardware or mixed-mode FR06 validation
numerical checks and this report are not Codex acceptance
sampled maxima are not a whole-domain proof; continuous claims rest on the recorded interval operators, bounds and error envelope

the P0 correction proves the collision error envelope is covered by the actual checker per-side expansion in the six frozen scenes; the counterexamples are controlled legal-perturbation constructions and are not evidence that any earlier candidate physically collided
the P1 exact-panel bound is a documented interval arithmetic certificate under the stated libm/IEEE-754 assumptions, not a formal floating-point proof

numbered_negative_coverage.requirement: thin obstacle between two coarse samples must reject the true swept volume
corner collision with a body heading different from the formation heading must use the real OBB front
the same model with a changed map, limits, goal or stale context/old audit digest must fail binding or be re-audited
an adapter defect that omits the Delta factor must be caught by independent bounds, never trusted from a segment self-report
a construction blocked for the whole-formation circumcircle but passable by the true OBBs must not be rejected for the large circle alone
a deliberately tiny sweep sample budget must fail the audit and remain non-executable
map boundary, unknown occupancy, start/goal collision, NO_MOTION collision, fake solver success, no accepted candidate and budget exhaustion are all non-executable failures

P0: a static start pose whose obstacle lies between the old per-side increment e/2 and the corrected increment e must pass the old baseline+e margin but be rejected by the corrected factor-2 envelope; checker half extents are computed explicitly
P0: the same near-contact counterexample at the static goal map boundary distinguishes the old and corrected per-side margin
P0: the NO_MOTION free hold applies the corrected per-side numerical envelope, not the full-width margin
P0: the 0.01 m swept-motion padding is kept as sampling protection and is not counted as numerical margin
P0: a vehicle pair uses the two-body gap reduction (margin - baseline) to cover the sum of the two per-vehicle envelopes
P0: closure inequality, per-side growth, expanded radius upper bound and all five collision contexts are explicitly checked
P1: the exact per-panel fourth-derivative interval bound must enclose dense samples of the actual derivative on the S2 12 m profile and a structured cubic

P1: the S2 12 m reference is confirmed at the restored 5e-8 m threshold with exact-panel arithmetic, an infeasible threshold fails closed, the frozen scene inputs and defaults bind 5e-8, and the G1 1e-7 m production contract is unchanged

pre_final_corrections.action: error_envelope now solves margin >= baseline + 2*max(e_i), checks the actual binary64 half-extent growth, uses the expanded checker radius, separates all five collision contexts and keeps the 0.01 m sweep padding as sampling protection only
pre_final_corrections.item: P0: collision.py had treated the full-width margin as if the legacy checker expanded each side by the full amount; the checker actually expands each side by margin/2

pre_final_corrections.action: references, frozen requests, support tools and the independent audit use 5e-8 m again.  The S2 12 m profile is confirmed by an exact per-panel interval fourth-derivative bound (integration_bounds) with the G1 1e-7 m production contract, floating/angle guard and fail-closed behaviour unchanged
pre_final_corrections.item: P1: the G4 scene freeze and independent audit had relaxed audit_position_budget_m from the accepted 5e-8 m to 1e-7 m

pre_final_corrections.action: refinement now adds even increments to the worst segment; the remainder formula, exact panel bound, guards and panel limits are unchanged
pre_final_corrections.item: audit refinement doubled a whole worst segment, so the panel-count-dependent guard overshot the threshold on S3

protection.note: G1/G2/G3 source and tests outside the G4 whitelist, old FR06 source, old maps and the old collision engine are unchanged. Path authorization is not Codex acceptance.

scene_freeze.collision_envelope_note: The legacy checker expands each body by margin_m/2 per side.  The G4 numerical envelope e is a physical distance, so the required closure is (margin_used - baseline)/2 >= max_i e_i, equivalently margin_used >= baseline + 2*max_i e_i.  Static start/goal, NO_MOTION hold, map boundary and vehicle-vehicle pairs use the actual binary64 half extents; the 0.01 m sweep padding is motion-sampling protection and is not counted as numerical margin.
scene_freeze.note: Maps and requests are frozen; modifications require a new scene version.  Reference files are not copied into inputs/.
scene_freeze.reference_geometry_audit_note: Independent geometry audit threshold is 5e-8 m, as fixed by G2 rework 01 and G2/G3 acceptance.  The S2 12 m curvature profile is confirmed by exact per-panel fourth-derivative interval bounds (integration_bounds), not by the coarse global triangle bound and not by sampling.  The production G1 1e-7 m contract, floating/angle guard, dynamic limits, collision margin, sweep step and vehicle geometry are unchanged.

envelope.radius_upper_note: radius_upper is an outward interval square root of the actual checker half extents (length+margin)/2 and (width+margin)/2 at the recorded margin; it is not the old fixed-point radius.  The margin is solved at this same expanded radius.
